text.text_excerpt: Joe's has a wonderful selection of wines! Whether you like Merlots, Cabernets, Pinot Grigio, Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc, or a Zinfandel this place has you covered. Joe is very kind and helpful. If you aren't sure exactly what wine pairs best with your food Joe will definitely help you out and suggest some choices. Prices are very reasonable. Joe's also has a good selection of Cordials/Mixers, Beer, and Liquor. The store is directly across the street from the Gold Mine. Open 7 days a week from 11:30am-till whenever Joe feels like closing (usually around 6p). The best wine cellar in the area!! I definitely recommend Joe's.

This is the place to go for Absinthe! I spoke to the owner for quite some time about Absinthe. Who knew there were so many varieties and varying qualities! They have hosted Absinthe tastings in the past. Very friendly and helpful staff! Like I said, I learned so much from the owner. I almost wished they had classes here! They also have a great selection of local Louisiana wines in the French Quarter for the best prices. I will gladly stop in here for local wines the next time I am down in NOLA.

Joe's was the best mistake I made yesterday! I was wandering around the quarter with two goals. 1) enjoy the beautiful weather and 2) don't spend much money. Joe's made accomplishing these goals three times easier :) He had a 3 for 13 sale on a few brands of wine. Cha - ching! I'll have to swing back by when I'm actually allowed to spend money.... I saw a few reposados calling out my name. From what I hear the owner doesn't hold consistent hours... so you'll have to poke your head in to see if they're open.
